mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate remains persistently below its long-run average for two consecutive months, market expectations of future rate cuts increase, lowering discount rates and boosting the present value of equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1-year average(FEDFUNDS) for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in qualifying periods are not statistically superior to the 60-day rolling mean (t-test p > 0.05), or the Fed raises rates within 3 months of the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid increases in employment (measured by PAYEMS) coincide with rising consumer confidence and business hiring momentum, which anticipate stronger economic growth and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 2-month moving average(PAYEMS) by at least 5,000 in a single month
failure_condition: Over a 30-day window of qualifying PAYEMS spikes, SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically outperforming the 5-day moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in industrial production (INDPRO) accompanied by a decline in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) suggests resilient supply and cooling demand pressures, lowering real rate expectations and pushing S&P 500 forward returns negative over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 2-week moving average(INDPRO) AND CPIAUCSL < 2-week moving average(CPIAUCSL)
failure_condition: In 20 such triggered events, SPX 5-day forward returns are not statistically worse than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) unexpectedly falls below 2% while manufacturing activity (GDPC1) remains elevated, markets anticipate a disinflationary path that reduces real policy rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Over 10 such events, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly higher than the 5-day rolling mean (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) followed by a sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a labor market cooling, prompting the Fed to pause rate hikes and lowering real rates, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In 15 such regimes, SPX 60-day forward returns under the trigger are not statistically superior to the 30-day rolling mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for three consecutive months without a corresponding drop in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests wage growth is decoupled from output, reducing deflation fears and supporting equity valuations, producing positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 2.0 for 3 consecutive months AND INDPRO > 2-month moving average(INDPRO)
failure_condition: Over 10 such episodes, SPX 20-day returns are not statistically higher than the 5-day moving average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in retail sales (not directly observable in the given proxies, but as a counterfactual: a sharp drop in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) and a rise in housing starts proxy via HOUST) signals resilient demand in the housing and consumer sectors, which elevates earnings expectations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 2-week moving average(HOUST) AND CPIAUCSL < 2-week moving average(CPIAUCSL)
failure_condition: In 8 such triggered windows, SPX 5-day forward returns are not statistically outperforming the 1-day moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls sharply for two consecutive months while consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains elevated above 3%, it signals a supply disruption without strong demand recovery, raising real policy rate expectations and pushing S&P 500 forward returns negative over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 2-month moving average(INDPRO) AND CPIAUCSL > 3.0 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Over 12 such events, SPX 20-day returns under the trigger are not statistically worse than the 5-day rolling mean (p > 0.05).
